reasons.plausibility: The proposed role of semicoherent interfaces in impeding dislocations and shifting creep mechanisms aligns well with known interface-driven strengthening concepts, though the stress-induced amorphization is moderately speculative.
reasons.testability: The hypothesis includes clear experimental variables (multilayer periodicities and nanoindentation creep tests) and unambiguous criteria for falsification based on measured stress exponents and interface characterization.
reasons.usefulness: These detailed conditions, predicted outcomes, and a straightforward falsification path provide a concrete framework for further investigation of interface effects on creep in high-entropy coatings.
